brand_identity.name: Garment Foundry
brand_identity.aesthetic: Black-and-white luxury aesthetic, refined serif typography, clean geometric sans-serif, quiet luxury, manufacturing-led.

headings.strategy: Uppercase for overlines/labels. Tight tracking for massive headings. Use lighter weights for elegant feel.

body.strategy: Geometric clarity. High legibility. Moderate tracking for overlines.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing. Use `p-12` or `p-24` for sections. The bento grid mode A (Tetris) for product categories. Mode B (Control Room) for multi-step quote calculator.
layout_and_spacing.borders: 1px sharp, solid borders with #333333. No soft neomorphic shadows. Use hard lines to emphasize precision and 'seam-lines'.
layout_and_spacing.grids: Pinstripe grid motifs in backgrounds. Use CSS repeating-linear-gradient to create subtle 1px pinstripes in section backgrounds (e.g., repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, transparent 100px, #333333 100px, #333333 101px)).

components_strategy.buttons: Sharp edges, 0px border-radius. 1px solid white border, transparent background, text white. On hover: bg-white text-black transition-all duration-300.
components_strategy.cards: Cardless or 0px radius cards with 1px border. Deep blacks. Use hover effects like subtle scale or border highlight (white).
components_strategy.inputs: Flat, bottom-border only or 1px full border, 0px radius. Minimalist aesthetic. Shadcn customized.
components_strategy.navigation: Premium sticky navigation. Glassmorphism using backdrop-blur-xl but keeping it dark (bg-black/80). Border bottom 1px solid #333333.
components_strategy.quote_calculator: Multi-step flow. Use Shadcn forms and progress indicators. Layout in a dense, precise dashboard-style grid to look highly functional yet premium.

motifs: GF monogram: Use as a decorative watermark in large, very faint typography or SVGs.
Stitched arc pattern: Use dashed SVG paths (e.g., stroke-dasharray='4 4') to simulate stitching lines dividing sections.
Pinstripe grid: Vertical 1px lines across the hero or background to simulate tailoring grid.
Seam-line motif: Instead of standard hr tags, use a 1px dashed line to represent a seam.
textures: Paper texture: Apply the generated paper texture image with blend-mode-multiply or very low opacity overlay.
Fabric texture: Use as hero overlay or background for specific sections.

hero_background.description: Wide-angle photograph of dark moody apparel manufacturing, extreme close-up of dark fabric weave and a steel needle. Use for Hero Section.

fabric_texture.description: Macro photography of raw cotton fabric texture. Use for 'About' or 'Capabilities' section backgrounds.

stitching_hands.description: Close-up black and white photograph of an artisan's hands carefully stitching a bespoke garment. Use for 'Manufacturing Process' or 'Quality Control'.

thread_spools.description: Row of thread spools in deep shadow. Use for 'Product Categories' or 'Sourcing'.

garment_construction.description: Black and white abstract shot of a suit pattern on a cutting table. Use for 'Why-us' or 'Design Support'.

monochrome_texture_paper.description: Thick luxury paper texture with subtle grain. Use as a global subtle overlay or background pattern.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the #000000, #333333, #777777, #F2F2F2 monochrome palette. No colors.
Use 'Cinzel' for headings (h1, h2, h3) and 'Montserrat' for body text. Install these from Google Fonts.
Ensure all interactive elements and buttons use sharp 0px border-radius.
Implement the 'stitched arc pattern' and 'pinstripe grid' using CSS borders, dashed lines, and repeating linear gradients.
Use the provided image URLs as dark, moody backgrounds with appropriate black gradient overlays (e.g., from-black/80 to-black/30) to ensure text readability.
The multi-step quote calculator must look like a high-end application interface, not a generic form. Use dense layout, clear step indicators, and sharp Shadcn inputs.
Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, links, inputs, and interactive components.
Make heavy use of negative space, large typography, and asymmetric bento grids (grid-cols-12 with varied spans) to achieve the 'quiet luxury' look.
